name: cadre
description: Secure cloud agent suite (159 specialist roles) with deterministic role selection and dispatch, reachable from any project once installed at global scope. Lifecycle governance (Agentic SDLC G1–G10 gates) is a separate, optional plugin — see cadre-lifecycle-core.

interface.shortDescription: System-wide secure cloud agent suite with deterministic role selection.
interface.longDescription: Makes 159 specialist roles, orchestration skills, and knowledge-store retrieval available as a self-contained package. Lifecycle governance is a separate, optional plugin (cadre-lifecycle-core).
defaultPrompt: Use run-agent-orchestration to review this task through the secure cloud agent suite.
